classification: Source original public tracking CSV event-sensor and temporal support audit only; not a biological hypothesis test or fitted individual effect
predefined_temporal_probe: potential repeated coverage: >=30 unique (individual-local-identifier,timestamp) georeferenced positions on >=3 distinct UTC calendar days. This is a screening diagnostic, not final ecological model eligibility.
sensor_primary_rule: Fine-grain 2D common-cell comparison requires GPS/verified equivalent positional precision. ARGOS-only is flagged separate low-precision/measurement-error sensitivity; not treated as high-accuracy GPS.

datasets.original_source_name: Satellite Tracking of Oceanic Loggerhead Turtles in the Mediterranean.csv
limitations: Same individual and timestamp repeat in source with potentially distinct location/quality data; collision count does not assert duplicate event IDs or identical coordinates.
Source location precision/Argos location classes may have much larger uncertainty than fine 500-m shared cells. No spatial/individual effect is estimated.
Potential 9 repeated animals are not an actual GPS-eligible cohort or a confirmed same site/year overlap sample.
GPS type alone cannot establish within-species individuality; this source has exactly one tracked animal in original public reference and track CSV.
No aggregate cross-individual statistic or resampling null can be estimated from one animal.

source_data_privacy: Only aggregate source GPS/Argos row counts, sensor types and temporal coverage; original individual IDs, coordinate rows and timestamps not copied into GitHub.
